title: Three-dimensional steady transonic shocks for the relativistic Euler equations
summary: We investigates the transonic shock problem for steady relativistic Euler equations in hemispherical shells. We show the existence and uniqueness of spherically symmetric transonic shock solutions via the shooting method and the monotonicity between the exit pressure and shock position. Furthermore, without any restrictions on background transonic shocks, we prove the existence and stability of transonic shocks under three dimensional perturbations of the exit pressure. The key techniques involve the decoupling the hyperbolic and elliptic components in steady relativistic Euler equations…
